blocks.text: Ada Tours is not responsible for missed hotel breakfasts when you check out early for a morning flight or excursion.

On arrival in Santiago, your driver will meet you and take you to your hotel. The transfer takes around **50 minutes**.

You can spend the rest of the day resting after the flight or taking a first walk around the capital on your own.
Cars on a street lined with high-rise buildings in Santiago, Chile
Santiago: city traffic beside glass high-rises

This sightseeing tour of Santiago lasts around **4 hours** and is led by an English-speaking guide.

The tour begins in the city centre, in the square by La Moneda Palace. Built in 1799 during the final years of Spanish rule, this neoclassical building housed the royal mint. It was handed over to the Chilean government in the mid-19th century and has served as a government residence ever since.

Next, head to Plaza de Armas, Santiago's main square. Here you will find the House of the Governors of Chile, City Hall, the Central Post Office, the Royal Audiencia building and the Metropolitan Cathedral.

After exploring the historic centre, you head up Santa Lucía Hill for a panoramic view of the city. The tour then continues through the modern districts of Vitacura, Las Condes and Providencia. You drive along the Mapocho River and see the architecture of Santiago's main avenues.
